test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Ten people are sitting in two parallel rows containing 5 people each, in such a way that there is equal distance between adjacent persons.

In Row 1 – A, B, C, D and E are seated and all of them are facing the north.

In Row 2 – P, Q, R, S and T are seated and all of them are facing the south.

Thus, each person is facing another person from the other row.

Neither A nor D is sitting at any of the extreme ends of the row. A is sitting to the immediate right of D. P is facing the person who is sitting second to the right of D. Only two people are sitting between P and Q. C is sitting to the immediate right of E. B is facing the person who is sitting second to the right of R. S is sitting at one of the positions to the right of T.

Who is facing T?
solution:
According to the given information,

1) Neither A nor D is sitting at any of the extreme ends of the row.

2) A is sitting to the immediate right of D.

3) P is facing the person who is sitting second to the right of D. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/db860244c5725c42715457ddd424cb7104209ac658ff2c6d033d635e96a6fcb3.png] 

4) Only two people are sitting between P and Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/85df87f35064b21f8f4de4be68a0b502a1115e1820550187353330de754f5265.png] 

5) C is sitting to the immediate right of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/71c9f571482d72f600bcf387c5197d1b132d074e1035837bb94d4a27a0e388ed.png] 

6) B is facing the person who is sitting second to the right of R.

7) S is sitting at one of the positions to the right of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8abfe788262cabd16d5b88a52ba85c00104de1c71d4e94260796953f9becccf0.png] 

Here, we can see that C is facing T.

Hence, the correct answer is **"C"**.
